pages.text: $(bold)Cavalry Officer's Pistol$()$(br2)A compact 16.5mm sidearm designed for fast engagement. While it has higher dispersion than a long musket, a cavalryman can carry up to two pistols at the hip.$(br2)$(c)Requires powered Create Mechanical Crafters.$() Standard crafting benches lack the precision to fit lock, barrel, and stock.

$(bold)Mechanical Crafter Grid (3x3)$()$(br2)B M R$(br)S W T$(br)  I L$(br2)$(bold)Legend:$()$(br)B: Pistol Barrel$(br)M: Flintlock Mechanism$(br)R: Ramrod$(br)S: Gun Screws$(br)W: Pistol Stock$(br)T: Barrel Band$(br)I: Tempered Gun Steel$(br)L: Leather

$(bold)Assembly Instructions$()$(br2)1. Place 8 Mechanical Crafters matching the grid (bottom-left empty).$(br)2. Connect rotational kinetic power (min 16 RPM).$(br)3. Wrench crafter arrows converging on the output.$(br)4. Insert ingredients and collect the finished, unloaded FK15-P.
